app/(legal)/privacy/page.tsx: ChessCoachPal is open-source chess coaching software. This describes the software, not the privacy policy of an unspecified hosting operator.

Session cookies authenticate teachers. Delegated AI clients receive teacher-authorized OAuth permissions. Optional email, payments, AI and other integrations can send information to providers selected by the operator or teacher. Never expose a service-role database key to a client or AI agent.

Teachers and operators must obtain applicable permissions, restrict access, handle correction and deletion requests, and meet their legal child-privacy obligations. Do not enter identifiable real students, personal records or production credentials in public demo or CI environments.

Teachers can export records from Account settings. Exports contain sensitive information and need separate protection. Operators must manage database and uploaded-object backups, retention, deletion and incident response. No hosting-region, retention period, contact address or contractual guarantee is implied by this open-source repository.

The application can store teacher accounts, workplaces, students and family contacts, birth dates, lesson schedules, attendance, private and shared coaching notes, chess learning observations and study links, invoices and payment records. Family portals are accessible to anyone with their private portal link; protect and rotate these links when necessary.

The teacher or organization running your instance controls its hosting, database, backups, logs, retention period, email delivery, optional payments and connected AI providers. ChessCoachPal contributors do not automatically receive records stored on independent installations. Contact your hosting operator for their privacy notice and privacy-request details.
for implementation guidance, and ask your deployment operator about their actual practices.
app/(legal)/terms/page.tsx: . This page does not amend the MIT license.
ChessCoachPal is self-hostable open-source chess teaching software, not a hosted service operated by the original CogNote publisher.

Each installation is run by its own operator. If your chess teacher, school, club or service provider hosts your account, ask them for applicable terms, data practices, pricing, support arrangements and availability. The source repository makes no claim that a specific paid hosting service or central support organization is available.

Installing this software does not create a subscription, hosting agreement, service-level guarantee or legal relationship with its contributors. Separate hosting contracts, if any, are between the user and their chosen operator.

Operators and teachers must obtain appropriate permissions to hold students' and families' records, protect credentials and private links, comply with applicable laws, and check redistribution rights before uploading teaching materials. Optional AI, payments and email services have separate provider terms.
Use, modification and redistribution of the source code are governed by the repository's MIT
